name: Regensburg Cathedral: doors
_about: Regensburg's doors: the main portal inside the triangular porch -- its great leaves shut, the wicket the way in -- the two tower portals, and the stair turrets' small doors. (+z is west, +x south.)

doors._about: the main portal, behind the triangular porch
the portals under the north and south towers
the transept portals, north and south
